tools.name: make_quiz
tools.description: Tjaz writes a multiple-choice quiz with its own AI from a description of what it's about, and the source material it's to be made from when there is any, for the people who will play it, and gives back a link to play it alone, in a 3D game or together on a big screen, and to share it. tools.name: save_quiz
tools.description: Saves a multiple-choice quiz whose questions are already written, by the user or by you, on Tjaz, and gives back a link to play it alone, in a 3D game or together on a big screen, and to share it. tools.name: find_quizzes
tools.description: Finds quizzes others have made on tjaz.com/quizzes, by words (typos are forgiven), subject and who they're for, and gives each with a link to play it. Use this when the user wants a quiz that may already exist, or quizzes to play

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.description: A quiz on Tjaz by its id or link (tjaz.com/q/…): its title, who it's for, its questions, and its links. The right answers only for the one who made it. Also tells whether a quiz being made is ready

tools.name: quiz_results
tools.description: How it went for those who played a quiz the user made: how many played it, how many answers were right on average, and each question with the share who answered it right, the hardest first, for everyone or for one class link. Only numbers for everyone together, never names, and only when at least 5

tools.name: class_link
tools.description: Makes a link to a quiz the user made for one class or group, with a QR code, so the results of those who play from it can be seen on their own. Needs the user logged in to Tjaz

tools.name: translate_quiz
tools.description: Translates a quiz on Tjaz into another language and gives back the link to the translation. Takes up to a minute
